title: Goodbye Christopher Robin
description: Author A.A. Milne finds inspiration from his son to write Winnie-the-Pooh and The House at Pooh Corner in the 1920s. His family soon becomes swept up in the success of the books, while the tales bring hope and comfort to postwar England.

title: Great Photo, Lovely Life
description: Photojournalist Amanda Mustard turns her investigative lens on sexual abuse committed by her grandfather, beginning a personal journey in pursuit of the truth and reconciliation for her family.

title: Siren: The Voices of Shelley Beattie
description: A dual portrait of actor Marlee Matlin and American Gladiator Shelley Beattie, aka Siren; deafness defined both of their lives in similar and different ways.

title: Succession
description:
S01 E01 — Celebration
Media magnate Logan Roy shocks his family on his 80th birthday by announcing he is staying on indefinitely as CEO of Waystar Royco; Logan's children raise objections over their father's desire to change the way his eventual successor will be chosen.

title: Succession
description:
S01 E02 — S... Show at the F... Factory
Logan's incapacitation sets off a heated succession debate among his children; Greg is tasked with retrieving important items from the Roy apartment; Kendall makes an impassioned final plea to keep Waystar Royco in the family.

title: Succession
description:
S01 E03 — Lifeboats
Kendall confronts a major crisis involving a secret bank debt as Waystar's stock plunges to dangerous lows; Kendall and Roman attend their first big meeting in their new roles; Kendall tries to convince Rava to give their marriage a second chance.

title: Succession
description:
S01 E04 — Sad Sack Wasp Trap
Kendall polishes up his speech for the company's annual foundation gala fundraiser; Shiv tries to minimize damage from a sordid photo that threatens a client's political future; Tom shares a disturbing file with Greg.

title: Succession
description:
S01 E05 — I Went to Market
After hearing Logan's plan to expand to local TV, Kendall begins to plot a vote of no confidence against his father; Greg drives his ornery grandfather, Ewan, from Canada to New York for a Thanksgiving reunion with Logan.

title: Succession
description:
S01 E06 — Which Side Are You On?
Logan arrives in Washington to meet the president but worries he has been snubbed following a last-minute cancellation; after successfully thwarting a potential scandal, Tom introduces Greg to fine dining; Shiv explores her options.

title: Succession
description:
S01 E07 — Austerlitz
In an effort to fix his public image, Logan agrees to a family therapy session at Connor's New Mexico ranch; Shiv is pushed to join the Gil Eavis' team, a potential presidential candidate who goes against everything Shiv's father stands for.

title: Succession
description:
S01 E08 — Prague
Tom has a bachelor party to remember; Kendall eyes a new business opportunity with a pair of idealistic entrepreneurs; Roman looks to land a deal for local TV stations with his father's longtime nemesis; Shiv and Gil get ambushed during an interview.

title: Succession
description:
S01 E09 — Pre-Nuptial
The Roys assemble at Eastnor Castle in England to prepare for Shiv and Tom's wedding; Kendall learns from Stewy and Sandy that their plot for a hostile takeover of Waystar has been fast-tracked in order to catch Logan off guard.

title: Succession
description:
S01 E10 — Nobody Is Ever Missing
News of a hostile takeover breaks; Kendall eyes an escape outlet.

title: Succession
description:
S02 E01 — The Summer Palace
Kendall tries to make amends with his father for his takeover attempt betrayal; Logan receives some unvarnished advice from his financial banker about the next best move for Waystar Royco; Tom maneuvers for a new position in the company.

title: Succession
description:
S02 E02 — The Vaulter
Roman and Kendall do a "routine health check" of a new media brand to help Vaulter to determine the future of the company; Tom tasks Greg with sniffing out waste at ATN; Connor and Willa host a soirée to mark their return to New York.

title: Succession
description:
S02 E03 — Hunting
Logan informs his management team of his plan to make another attempt to acquire a rival media company; Greg worries his meeting with a Logan biographer puts his standing with the family at risk; Connor's presidential announcement irritates Logan.

title: Succession
description:
S02 E04 — Safe Room
Roman begins a six-week management training program; Connor and Willa attend the funeral of a family friend with a complicated past; Logan and Kendall arrange a covert meeting with PGM CEO Rhea Jarrell; controversy surrounds a star anchor.

title: Succession
description:
S02 E05 — Tern Haven
Logan attempts to solidify his buyout of PGM at a weekend retreat at the Pierce family home; Shiv, Roman and Connor veer from their carefully orchestrated roles; the Pierces question whether an alliance with Waystar Royco will tarnish their legacy.

title: Succession
description:
S02 E06 — Argestes
As Logan looks to finalize a deal to buy the Pierce family's papers and TV stations, a threat to the deal arises from an unexpected quarter; Tom worries about ATN's new slogan after learning some distressing news from Greg.

title: Succession
description:
S02 E07 — Return
When Kendall and Roman are sent to the U.K. to negotiate with their mother, an uninvited Shiv shows up to get answers from her father, who has been dodging her; Rhea's continued presence raises eyebrows among the Roy kids, as Logan seeks her counsel.

title: Succession
description:
S02 E08 — Dundee
The entire Roy clan travels to Logan's hometown of Dundee, Scotland, for a celebration of Logan's 50 years in the business; Kendall becomes enamored with Jennifer, an actress in Willa's play; a former employee proves difficult to silence.

title: Succession
description:
S02 E09 — DC
Logan, Kendall, Gerri and Tom testify before Congress; Shiv speaks candidly to Kira, a victim who is set to be a key witness; in Turkey, Roman's business pitch takes a chilling turn.

title: Succession
description:
S02 E10 — This Is Not for Tears
Logan weighs whether a member of the family, or a top lieutenant, will need to be sacrificed to salvage the company's tarnished reputation. Roman shares his hesitations about a new source of financing, as Kendall suggests a familiar alternative.

title: Succession
description:
S03 E01 — Secession
Following his bombshell press conference, a righteous Kendall scrambles to find a base of operations while Logan's team searches for safe harbor.

title: Succession
description:
S03 E02 — Mass in Time of War
Kendall tries to get his siblings, as well as Stewy and Sandi, on his side; fearing his legal situation, Greg asks Ewan for help.

title: Succession
description:
S03 E03 — The Disruption
With the DOJ at the door, Logan summons his arsenal, while Tom makes a potentially life-changing offer; Kendall becomes obsessed with his own takedown.

title: Succession
description:
S03 E04 — Lion in the Meadow
Logan and Kendall have their first meeting together with Josh, a major investor worried about their family feud.

title: Succession
description:
S03 E05 — Retired Janitors of Idaho
Kendall and the Waystar team find themselves working together at the annual shareholders' meeting.

title: Succession
description:
S03 E06 — What It Takes
Logan and the team head to Virginia for a conservative political conference, where Roman learns some surprising news.

title: Succession
description:
S03 E07 — Too Much Birthday
At Kendall's lavish birthday bash, Shiv and Roman try to arrange a meeting with Lukas Matsson, a tech mogul who recently snubbed Logan.

title: Succession
description:
S03 E08 — Chiantishire
At a wedding in Italy, Roman airs suspicions; Gerri draws a line, and the Waystar team grows concerned over rogue tweets.

title: Succession
description:
S03 E09 — All the Bells Say
Matsson's vision for the GoJo-Waystar relationship leads Shiv and Roman to manage the fallout; Logan weighs his options.

title: Succession
description:
S04 E01 — The Munsters
As Kendall, Shiv and Roman hone their pitch for potential investors in Los Angeles, a call from Tom shifts the siblings' focus; Greg's uninvited plus-one raises questions at Logan's birthday party; Tom seeks assurances from Logan.

title: Succession
description:
S04 E02 — Rehearsal
After Shiv discovers that Tom is following Logan's playbook, she, Kendall and Roman consider backing Sandi and Stewy's aggressive play on the Matsson deal; Logan gives an impromptu pep talk to the ATN newsroom and outsources a tricky conversation.

title: Succession
description:
S04 E03 — Connor's Wedding
While Logan doles out an unsavory task ahead of his trip to meet Matsson, Connor fixates on minutia at his wedding.

title: Succession
description:
S04 E04 — Honeymoon States
As Roman, Kendall and Shiv navigate a misstep with Matsson, the Waystar team discusses a pivotal recommendation to the board ahead of the GoJo sale; angling for position, Kendall seeks support from Stewy and Hugo.

title: Succession
description:
S04 E05 — Kill List
After the Waystar team heads to Norway, Shiv, Kendall and Roman consider whether to fight for Logan's crown jewel.

title: Succession
description:
S04 E06 — Living+
Ahead of Investor Day, Shiv weighs a proposal from Matsson; Kendall and Roman each try to match Logan's volatile leadership style.

title: Succession
description:
S04 E07 — Tailgate Party
Hoping to work the angles, Kendall and Roman ask Shiv to invite a campaign insider to Logan's pre-election day party.

title: Succession
description:
S04 E08 — America Decides
On election night, Tom tries to manage an increasingly chaotic newsroom while Kendall, Shiv and Roman spar over the consequences for themselves, the company and the country.

title: Succession
description:
S04 E09 — Church and State
As the family girds themselves for an emotional funeral, Kendall finds himself at odds with Rava and inopportune news from Jess; Shiv tries to reposition herself within a new political landscape, as Kendall rallies supporters to his side.

title: Succession
description:
S04 E10 — With Open Eyes
Ahead of the final board vote on the Waystar-GoJo deal, Kendall and Shiv try to shore up their opposing interests and get a fix on the whereabouts of a physically and emotionally bruised Roman.

title: Maze Runner: The Death Cure
description: Thomas leads some escaped Gladers on their final and most dangerous mission yet. To save their friends, they must break into the legendary Last City, a WCKD-controlled labyrinth that may turn out to be the deadliest maze of all.

title: Dune
description: Paul Atreides, a brilliant and gifted young man born into a great destiny beyond his understanding, must travel to the most dangerous planet in the universe to ensure the future of his family and his people.

title: Dune: Part Two
description: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the universe, he must prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

title: Lovecraft Country
description:
S01 E01 — Sundown
Atticus Freeman embarks on a journey in search of his missing father, Montrose; after recruiting his uncle, George, and childhood friend, Letitia, to join him, the trio sets out for Ardham, Mass., where they think Montrose may have gone.

title: Lovecraft Country
description:
S01 E02 — Whitey's on the Moon
Recovered from their terrifying night, Leti and George luxuriate in their new surroundings, while Atticus grows suspicious of their Ardham Lodge hosts who unveil cryptic plans for Atticus' role in their upcoming "Sons of Adam" ceremony.

title: Lovecraft Country
description:
S01 E03 — Holy Ghost
Leti turns a ramshackle Victorian on Chicago's North Side into a boarding house, an endeavor that stokes racism and awakens dormant spirits stuck in the house; George's wife, Hippolyta, presses Atticus for the full story of what happened in Ardham.

title: Lovecraft Country
description:
S01 E04 — A History of Violence
After Christina shows up at her doorstep, Leti confronts Atticus about his plan to surreptitiously return to Florida; in search of missing pages to a crucial text, Leti, Tic and Montrose head to Boston, with Hippolyta and Diana along for the ride.

title: Lovecraft Country
description:
S01 E05 — Strange Case
After making a devil's bargain with William, Ruby steps into the charmed shoes of a white woman; a betrayal by Montrose unleashes Atticus' pent-up rage, leaving Leti deeply disturbed and sending Montrose into the comforting arms of his secret lover.

title: Lovecraft Country
description:
S01 E06 — Meet Me in Daegu
In the throes of the Korean War, nursing student Ji-Ah crosses paths with a wounded Atticus, who has no recollection of their first encounter.

title: Lovecraft Country
description:
S01 E07 — I Am.
Hippolyta's relentless search for answers takes her on a multidimensional journey of self-discovery; Atticus heads to St. Louis to consult an old family friend.

title: Lovecraft Country
description:
S01 E08 — Jig-A-Bobo
Diana finds herself in Capt. Lancaster's crosshairs; when a visitor from the past arrives, Atticus and Leti take steps to protect their future.

title: Lovecraft Country
description:
S01 E09 — Rewind 1921
Leti, Tic, and Montrose travel to Tulsa in 1921 to try to save Dee.

title: Lovecraft Country
description:
S01 E10 — Full Circle
After discovering the truth about the origin of the Book of Names, Atticus and his relatives return to Ardham to cast a final spell there.

title: Jaÿ-Z in 8
description:
S01 E01 — Chapter 1
JAŸ-Z delves into his songs "Intro", "Meet the Parents" and "Can't Knock the Hustle" with longtime friend and music producer Rick Rubin, expanding on how his childhood in Brooklyn and teenage years in New Jersey influenced his creative process.

title: Jaÿ-Z in 8
description:
S01 E02 — Chapter 2
JAŸ-Z discusses the pitfalls of early fame, the East Coast-West Coast rap beef, and his relationships with The Notorious B.I.G. and Tupac.

title: Jaÿ-Z in 8
description:
S01 E03 — Chapter 3
Rubin probes JAŸ-Z on his storytelling, lyrical choices, and the vulnerabilities he experienced while making his 13th album, "4:44".

title: Jaÿ-Z in 8
description:
S01 E04 — Chapter 4
JAŸ-Z talks about reconnecting with his father as a teenager and how his potential retirement informed the creation of "The Black Album".

title: Jaÿ-Z in 8
description:
S01 E05 — Chapter 5
JAŸ-Z discusses the price of celebrity, paving the way for others, and embracing multiple interpretations of his work.

title: Jaÿ-Z in 8
description:
S01 E06 — Chapter 6
JAŸ-Z and producer Rick Rubin discuss the politics of the music industry and life after "The Black Album".

title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
description: Twentieth-century teenagers (Leonardo DiCaprio, Claire Danes) fall in love, despite feuding families, in an update of the classic tragedy.

title: The Firm
description: A law-school grad uncovers a sinister secret about the Tennessee firm that made him an offer he couldn't refuse.

title: War of the Worlds
description: A New Jersey man (Tom Cruise) and his two children face an epic battle for survival when hostile aliens invade Earth.

title: The Pet Cemetery Murders: A Ghost Story
description:
S01 E01
A decades-old Louisiana cold case involving the gruesome death of Dorothy Lou Thompson, the owner of a pet cemetery, gains traction after a startling account launches investigators down various haunting leads.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E01 — The Pilot
Teddy, Phil, Lilly, and Ronnie vow to figure out why so many kids have gone missing in Derry; Major Leroy Hanlon arrives at Derry Air Force Base, where he navigates a chilly reception from some of his fellow airmen.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E02 — The Thing in the Dark
Charlotte and Will navigate their new life at the town of Derry; Ronnie worries about her father's fate.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E03 — Now You See It
General Shaw pushes ahead with his mission, ordering Leroy and Pauly to escort Dick Hallorann on an aerial search for a new dig site; Rose attends a tribal meeting; Ronnie, Lilly, Will, and Rich attempt to get visual proof by conjuring an Orixá.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E04 — The Great Swirling Apparatus of Our Planet's Function
Children encounter frightening situations while Charlotte supports Hank and General Shaw increases pressure.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E05 — 29 Neibolt Street
After learning the truth about General Shaw's operation, Leroy decides to move his family to the base for safety; while the tribal Keepers strategize how to contain increased aggression in town, the military descends on Neibolt Street.
